basic_info.description: Quintessential Haight-Ashbury living meets modern comfort in this beautifully remodeled full-floor flat, ideally located just half a block from the iconic shops and restaurants on Haight, and moments from the Panhandle, Golden Gate Park, Haight Street Market, and Whole Foods. Offering ~1,479 sq ft, this 2 bed, 1.5 bath home blends classic San Francisco charm with thoughtful modern updates.    Enjoy warm wood floors, high ceilings, and a bright, open layout. The kitchen was remodeled in 2021, complemented by updated bathrooms, new central heating, electrical, plumbing, and sewer lateral. Additional features include in-unit laundry room, deeded exclusive storage, and one tandem parking space in the shared garage.    A large, level shared backyard provides rare outdoor space in the city. Low HOA dues (~$360/mo) cover trash, shared utilities, insurance, and reserves.    With an unbeatable location near parks, shops, dining, and transit, this elegant flat delivers the best of city living  a perfect blend of period character, comfort, and convenience. Offers, if any, will be reviewed Thursday 10/16 by 10am.
